### Brenda Poels new Chair of the Supervisory Board

Starting 1 December 2026

Date

2 November 2026

Brenda Poels has been appointed Chair of the Supervisory Board of Kunsthal Rotterdam, starting her duties on 1 December 2026.

[Brenda Poels new Chair of the Supervisory Board](/en/news/brenda-poels-new-chair-of-the-supervisory-board/)

![Iris van Herpen: Sculpting the Senses](https://assets.kunsthal.nl/glide/containers/images/lr_winnaar_museumtijdschrift_tentoonstellingsprijs2026_kunsthal_rotterdam_foto_rosalie_van_der_does.jpg/01e8bdb6af3bd3dd9efd795eed462682/lr_winnaar_museumtijdschrift_tentoonstellingsprijs2026_kunsthal_rotterdam_foto_rosalie_van_der_does.webp)

### Kunsthal Rotterdam wins the Museumtijdschrift Exhibition Award 2026

Iris van Herpen: Sculpting the Senses

Date

7 October 2026

The exhibition Iris van Herpen: Sculpting the Senses was announced as the winner of the 2026 Museumtijdschrift Exhibition Prize on 7 October.

[Kunsthal Rotterdam wins the Museumtijdschrift Exhibition Award 2026](/en/news/kunsthal-rotterdam-wins-the-museumtijdschrift-exhibition-award-2026/)

![](https://assets.kunsthal.nl/glide/containers/images/monira-al-qadiri,-the-disturbance,-2023,-commissioned-by-mori-art-museum.jpg/1552cef11d9e3c63738cd7773b587d95/monira-al-qadiri,-the-disturbance,-2023,-commissioned-by-mori-art-museum.webp)

### Exhibitions to look forward to

Kunsthal Highlights 2027

Date

5 October 2026

In 2027, Kunsthal Rotterdam will once again present a diverse and richly contrasting programme in its main galleries, featuring a wide range of artists, creators and stories – from Monira Al Qadiri and Jean Jullien to Luigi & Iango. The year will draw to a grand close in December with an impressive exhibition by Anish Kapoor.

[Exhibitions to look forward to](/en/news/exhibitions-to-look-forward-to/)
